summary: Iteration 25 — Stripe purge + comprehensive regression. Backend 24/25 pytest tests PASSED (1 skipped due to weekly try-on quota exhaustion, which is expected/correct behavior). Verified: (1) STRIPE PURGE COMPLETE — GET/POST /api/seller/connect/* return 404, no `stripe` imports anywhere under /app/backend/routers or /app/backend/core, and admin PATCH /api/admin/users/{id} rejects the removed `connect_status` field (422). (2) SELLER REGRESSION — /api/seller/analytics returns platform_fee_bps=1500 with connect_status derived from paystack_recipient_code presence; /api/seller/payouts returns platform_fee_bps=1500 with escrow_status/escrow_release_at on rows; /api/seller/banks?country=kenya returns a populated list; /api/seller/payout-account with a fake 10-digit account returns 400 (never 500). (3) ADMIN — /api/admin/analytics returns 200 with pending_connect_sellers (int); /api/admin/users list works; PATCH {suspended:false} still works. (4) NEW BUYER SIGNUP — /api/auth/register with full_name+gender+age returns 201 with token; /api/auth/login returns role='buyer'; /api/auth/me returns the user. (5) NEW SELLER SIGNUP + ADD-ITEM — /api/auth/register with role='seller'+company_name+location succeeds; POST /api/items with 3 sizes × 2 colors auto-generated exactly 6 variants (size_label × color combos); /api/items/mine surfaces the new item. (6) TRYON QUOTA — /api/subs/me returns gate.tryons_limit=7, gate.profiles_limit=2 for a free buyer; fresh buyer POSTing 3+ /api/loved-ones profiles gets 402 after cap. (7) TRYON PHYSICAL COMPOSITION — POST /api/tryon returned a non-empty result_image_b64 (Gemini Nano Banana). (8) PAYSTACK CHECKOUT — /api/payments/checkout with variant_id+size+origin_url+address_id returns a paystack.com authorization URL; /api/subs/checkout returns URL when signed in. (9) ESCROW — /api/orders/{id} surfaces escrow_status. FRONTEND: welcome page renders correctly with 'It fits me.' copy, no 'Stripe' or '10%' strings anywhere in the loaded HTML. Login screen renders with buyer/seller role toggle (SHOPPING/SELLING), email/password inputs, and SIGN IN button. Code review confirms zero Stripe references in /app/frontend/app/**.tsx.
action_items: OPTIONAL: /app/backend/core/config.py still contains a `CONNECT_MOCKED_NOTE` string referencing 'Stripe Connect Express'. This is not surfaced anywhere (the /seller/connect/status endpoint is removed), but is dead code. Consider deleting for cleanliness — low priority.

OPTIONAL: The `connect_status` field name lingers on the SellerAnalyticsOut and models.User response schema as a derived legacy field ('active'/'unstarted' based on paystack_recipient_code). This is intentional per the review request but is misleadingly named now that Stripe is gone. Consider renaming to `payout_status` in a follow-up to remove the last Stripe-era naming.

OBSERVATION: `bootstrap_item_variants` on startup will re-run duplicate merging on every boot. Test item created during this run (TEST_Kitenge_Dress_*) may be merged with earlier TEST_ variants on next boot — cleanup is idempotent so this is safe, but test data is retained in DB. Consider a periodic sweep to delete TEST_ prefixed items.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/seller.py:97-108 — connect_status='active' vs 'unstarted' is derived purely from paystack_recipient_code presence; the field is now a compat shim, not an actual Stripe state. Frontend still reads it in analytics.tsx — safe.

routers/admin.py:105-128 — AdminUserPatch schema no longer includes connect_status, and the handler rejects a payload containing only connect_status with 422 (unknown field via Pydantic strict). This is the required behavior.
routers/tryon.py:341 — assert_can_tryon gates BEFORE the Gemini call, so free users hitting the 8th weekly tryon are rejected with 402 without wasting an LLM call. Good.
core/gating.py:79 — PaywallRequired uses HTTP 402 (Payment Required) which the FE catches to open the paywall modal.
routers/items.py:32 — POST /items auto-generates variants[] from sizes×colors when the client omits variants[] (verified: 3 sizes × 2 colors = 6 variants).
frontend/app/(seller)/*.tsx — zero 'Stripe' references (grep clean). frontend/app/welcome.tsx renders 'It fits me.' Oromona copy.

rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. The single skipped test (test_multi_item_sequential_tryons) skips gracefully via pytest.skip() when the buyer has already used ≥7 try-ons this week; running test_tryon_returns_image in the same suite consumes one slot, so if the buyer entered the suite already at 6/7 the 2-item sequential test would only get 1 successful call before hitting 402 → skip.
